# OKF v0.2 Knowledge Catalog Example

This knowledge catalog demonstrates Google's OKF v0.2 specification featuring:
- **Trust Signals**: Provenance (`sources`), Trust (`generated`/`verified`), Freshness (`stale_after`), and Lifecycle (`status`).
- **Attested Computation**: Sanctioned calculation queries (`type: Attestation`).
